# PLot phylogeny 
```{r}
# Import tree
setwd("/Users/ruchita/Documents/Harvard/Lab/CDC/GBS GWAS/")
tr  <- read.tree("GBS_GWAS_FastTree_phylo_rooted_GAS.tre")
OUT <- grep("SRR32569359", tr$tip.label, value = TRUE)[1]
if (!is.null(tr$root.edge)) tr$root.edge <- NULL
if (!is.na(OUT) && OUT %in% tr$tip.label) tr <- drop.tip(tr, OUT)
tr <- phangorn::midpoint(tr)
tr <- ladderize(tr, right = TRUE)



# Load metadata
setwd("/Users/ruchita/Documents/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
serotypes <- read.table("Serotypes.txt", header=T)
CCs <- read.csv("combined_results_with_cc.txt")
SCs <- read.csv("GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)

# Load phenotypes
setwd("/Users/ruchita/Documents/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
phenotypes <- read.table("phenotypes.txt", header=T)
phenotypes <- phenotypes |>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(continuous<=7, "EOD", 
                          ifelse(continuous<=89, "LOD", "VLOD")))
# Prep metadata for tree
typing_data <- left_join(left_join(left_join(serotypes, CCs), SCs), phenotypes)
fewer5_SC <- which(table(typing_data$SC)<=5)
metadata_tree_v0 <- typing_data |>
  mutate(SC2= ifelse(SC %in% fewer5_SC, "other", SC))|>
  mutate(SC2= factor(SC2, level=c(1:12, "other")))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG,"\\*"),"\\?"))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2))|>
  mutate(Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2, levels=c("Ia", "Ib","II", "III", "IV", "V","VI", "VIII")))|> 
  rename("label" = "Sample")|> 
  filter(label %in% tr$tip.label)

# Join metadata and tree 
Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid_metadata <- full_join(keep.tip(tr, metadata_tree_v0$label), metadata_tree_v0 , by = 'label')


# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## Serotype
Metadata_Serotype = metadata_tree_v0 |> select(Serotype2)
row.names(Metadata_Serotype) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Serotype)= c("1")
## CC
Metadata_CC= metadata_tree_v0 |> select(clonal_complex)
row.names(Metadata_CC) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_CC)= c("2")
## Age category
Metadata_Age_cat= metadata_tree_v0 |> select(Age_cat)
row.names(Metadata_Age_cat) <-  metadata_tree_v0$label
colnames(Metadata_Age_cat)= c("3")

# Prepare colors for phylo
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd","#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf", "#f7b6d2",  "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94", "black")
sero_lvls <- levels(Metadata_Serotype[,1])

Serotype_colors <- c(
  "Ia"   = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "Ib"   = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "II"   = "#009E73",  # bluish green
  "III"  = "#D55E00",  # vermillion
  "IV"   = "#CC79A7",  # reddish purple
  "V"    = "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "VI"   = "#F0E442",  # yellow
  "VIII" = "#999999"   # gray (avoid black since SC uses it)
)[sero_lvls]           # reorder to your factor levels
names(Serotype_colors) <- levels(Metadata_Serotype[,1])
CC_colors <- carto.pal(pal1 = "pastel.pal" ,n1 = 12)
Age_cat_colors <- c("#004488", "#DDAA33", "#BB5566")

# SC tips
Fasttre_p1 <- ggtree(Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) + 
  geom_tippoint(aes(color=as.factor(SC2)),size=1.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(name="SC", values=SC_colors)+ 
  ggtree::vexpand(.15, -1)
# WITHOUT LEGEND
Fasttre_p1_noleg <-  ggtree(Fasttree_VLOD_DP_mid_metadata, ladderize = T, lwd=0.1) 

# Serotype
Fasttre_p2 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p1 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Serotype ,  width=0.15, offset=0.0005, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -50, color=NA)+
scale_fill_manual(
  values = Serotype_colors,
  name   = "1: Serotype",
  breaks = names(Serotype_colors),  # keep order
  drop   = FALSE,
  guide  = guide_legend(
    ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE,         # <- 2 columns = easier to read
    keyheight = unit(3, "mm"),
    keywidth  = unit(6, "mm"),
    title.position = "top"
  )
)
Fasttre_p2_leg <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p1_noleg + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Serotype ,  width=0.15, offset=0.0005, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -10, color=NA)+
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = Serotype_colors,
  name   = "1: Serotype",
  breaks = names(Serotype_colors),  # keep order
  drop   = FALSE,
  guide  = guide_legend(
    ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE,         # <- 2 columns = easier to read
    keyheight = unit(3, "mm"),
    keywidth  = unit(6, "mm"),
    title.position = "top"
  )
)

# CCs
Fasttre_p3 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p2 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_CC,  width=0.15, offset=0.005,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -50, color=NA)+

Fasttre_p3_leg <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p1_noleg + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_CC,  width=0.15, offset=0.005,

#  Age category
Fasttre_p4 <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p3 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Age_cat,  width=0.15, offset=0.01,

Fasttre_p4
Fasttre_p4_leg <- gheatmap(Fasttre_p1_noleg + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_Age_cat,  width=0.15, offset=0.01,

)

ggsave(

    "/Users/ruchita/Documents/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC",
```

SC Specific Phylogenies

```{r}
## ---- packages ----
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(ggnewscale)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(RColorBrewer)   # for CC palette

## ---- I/O paths ----
setwd("/Users/ruchita/Documents/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
tr  <- read.tree("GBS_GWAS_FastTree_phylo_rooted_GAS.tre")

# root/drop outgroup, midpoint, ladderize
OUT <- grep("SRR32569359", tr$tip.label, value = TRUE)[1]
if (!is.null(tr$root.edge)) tr$root.edge <- NULL
if (!is.na(OUT) && OUT %in% tr$tip.label) tr <- drop.tip(tr, OUT)
tr <- phangorn::midpoint(tr)
tr <- ladderize(tr, right = TRUE)

## ---- metadata ----
setwd("/Users/ruchita/Documents/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
serotypes <- read.table("Serotypes.txt", header=TRUE)
CCs       <- read.csv("combined_results_with_cc.txt")
SCs       <- read.csv("GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |>
  rename(Sample = Taxon, SC = Cluster)
phenotypes <- read.table("phenotypes.txt", header=TRUE) |>
  rename(Sample = samples) |>
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(continuous <= 7, "EOD",
                   ifelse(continuous <= 89, "LOD", "VLOD")))

typing_data <- serotypes |>
  left_join(CCs, by = "Sample") |>
  left_join(SCs, by = "Sample") |>
  left_join(phenotypes, by = "Sample")

# tidy serotype labels
typing_data <- typing_data |>
  mutate(
    Serotype2 = str_remove(str_remove(GBS.SBG, "\\*"), "\\?"),
    Serotype2 = ifelse(grepl("III-", Serotype2), "III", Serotype2),
    Serotype2 = factor(Serotype2,
                       levels = c("Ia","Ib","II","III","IV","V","VI","VIII"))
  )

# keep samples present in the tree
typing_data <- typing_data |>
  rename(label = Sample) |>
  filter(label %in% tr$tip.label)

## ---- define "main SCs" ----
# treat "main" as SCs with >5 isolates (change the threshold if you truly want the top 14)
sc_counts <- table(typing_data$SC)
main_SCs  <- names(sc_counts[sc_counts > 5])
main_SCs  <- sort(as.integer(main_SCs))  # pretty ordering

# If you explicitly want exactly 14 SCs regardless of size, uncomment:
# main_SCs <- sort(as.integer(names(sort(sc_counts, decreasing = TRUE)[1:14])))

## ---- palettes ----
# Serotype (Okabe–Ito; color-blind friendly)
Serotype_colors <- c(
  "Ia"   = "#0072B2", "Ib"   = "#E69F00", "II"   = "#009E73",
  "III"  = "#D55E00", "IV"   = "#CC79A7", "V"    = "#56B4E9",
  "VI"   = "#F0E442", "VIII" = "#999999"
)

# CC palette (Pastel1 has 9; expand with Set3 to reach 12+ if needed)
CC_colors <- c(brewer.pal(9, "Pastel1"),
               brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))[1:12]
names(CC_colors) <- sort(unique(typing_data$clonal_complex))[seq_along(CC_colors)]

## ---- helper: build one plot for an SC ----
plot_sc <- function(sc_id) {
  dat_sc <- typing_data |> filter(SC == sc_id)

  # prune tree to tips in this SC
  tr_sc  <- keep.tip(tr, dat_sc$label)

  # CC heatmap data
  meta_cc <- dat_sc |> select(clonal_complex)
  rownames(meta_cc) <- dat_sc$label
  colnames(meta_cc) <- "CC"

  # which serotypes are present here?
  present_sero <- levels(droplevels(dat_sc$Serotype2))
  sero_cols_present <- Serotype_colors[present_sero]

  # base tree – tips colored by Serotype; legend shows only present serotypes
  p <- ggtree(tr_sc, ladderize = TRUE, lwd = 0.1) +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = dat_sc$Serotype2[match(label, dat_sc$label)]),
                  size = 1.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = sero_cols_present,
      breaks = present_sero,   # legend only for serotypes in this SC
      name   = "Serotype"
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE, title.position = "top",
      override.aes = list(size = 3)  # nicer legend dots
    )) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    ggtree::vexpand(.12, -1)  # a bit less right padding since CC is closer

  # add ONLY CC heatmap, closer to the tips (smaller offset)
  p <- gheatmap(p + new_scale_fill(), meta_cc,
                width = 0.10, offset = 0.0015,   # <-- closer than before
                font.size = 5, colnames_offset_y = -18, color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = CC_colors, name = "1: CC",
      guide = guide_legend(title.position = "top")
    )

  p + ggtitle(paste0("SC ", sc_id))
}


## ---- build + save all ----
plots_by_sc <- lapply(main_SCs, function(sc) {
  message("Making plot for SC ", sc)
  p <- plot_sc(sc)
  
  # Print each plot so you can view it interactively
  print(p)
  
  # Save each plot to your specified folder
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    "/Users/ruchita/Documents/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC",
    paste0("phylo_SC", sc, ".pdf")
  ),
  plot = p,
  width = 7.5,
  height = 5.2,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"   # ← simple and reliable
)
  
  p  # keep it in the list
})

names(plots_by_sc) <- paste0("SC_", main_SCs)
```

# 1.1. SNP-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))
SNPGWAS_sig <-SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM))

# Load SNP distribution across samples
sig_SNPs <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/Sig_SNP.txt")
sig_SNPs_df <- sig_SNPs  |> 
  select(- X.CHROM, -ID, -QUAL, -FILTER, -INFO, -FORMAT)|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1/1", .), 1, 0)))|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(4:1543), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / 1540, 3))|>
  mutate(across(4:1543, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))|>
  mutate(MUT= paste0(REF, POS, ALT), .before = 1)|> 
  select(-POS, -REF, -ALT)
```

```{r}
# Load GWAS results
DBGWAS_FastTree <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)
DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/DBGWAS_Fasttree_DP_LMM_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F) |> filter(V2 >=0.05, V2 <0.95)
colnames(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations) <- colnames(DBGWAS_FastTree)
DBGWAS_FastTree_sig <- DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations |>  
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations)) |>
  mutate(contig = str_extract(notes, "^[^:]+"),
         coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"), 
         start= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,1], 
         end= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,2])|>
  select(variant, contig, start, end)

# Load Unitig distribution across samples
Sig_Unitig <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/Sig_Unitig.txt", sep=" ", header=F)|>
  select(-V2)
Sig_Unitig[] <- lapply(Sig_Unitig, function(x) gsub(":1", "", x)) 
order_unitigs <- c("ATCTTTTAAAATAGAAACTGTTATTTTTTGCA", "TTGTTGATCATTATGTCCTAGACCTAAAGCATGTCCTAA", "AATATTTCGTTTAACAAAAAAAATACTTTGCGAGGTCTCCATGCAGA", "AGCGACGTTTATGAATGCAGTTTCTAAAGGAAAAAAA", "TTTATGAATGCAGTTTCTAAAGGAAAAAAAACTATTGTGG", "TGTAGATATTGAAAGGTTACAAAATGTAGTCTATGAGGG", "TCGGTTCGAATGTGGGATAACACATTCGTCCAC", "GACGAATGTGTTATCCCACATTCGAACCGACCTGTT", "AAAAATGTTTGAATTAGGTAGTAATATTGACA", "TGATAATAGTGGAGAAATTTGTGATAATTTATCTCA", "AAATTATCACAAATTTCTCCACTATTATCAGTGGATCCATCAT", "TTTAGAAACTGCATTCATAAACGTCGCTGGGCCGCCATGTGTGAT" )
Sig_Unitig <- Sig_Unitig |>
  filter(V1 %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(V1 = factor(V1, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(V1)

Unitig_sig_t <- metadata_tree_v0 %>% select(label)
for(i in 1:nrow(Sig_Unitig)){
  present_samples <- as.vector(unlist(Sig_Unitig[i, -1]))
  new_var <- ifelse(Unitig_sig_t$label %in% present_samples, 1, 0)
  Unitig_sig_t[[paste0("Unitig_", i)]] <- new_var
}
row.names(Unitig_sig_t) <- Unitig_sig_t$label
Unitig_sig_t <- Unitig_sig_t[,-1]
round(colMeans(Unitig_sig_t %>% select(starts_with("Unitig_"))),3)

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo

metadata_unitig_list <- lapply(unitig_cols, function(u_col) {

  df[[u_col]] <- as.factor(df[[u_col]])      # convert column to factor
  row.names(df) <- row.names(Unitig_sig_t)   # set rownames
  colnames(df) <- u_col                     # ensure column name matches
  df
})
```

# 1.3. Pan-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
PanGWAS_FastTree <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/PanGWAS_FastTree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)
 PanGWAS_FastTree_sig <- PanGWAS_FastTree |> filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 / nrow(PanGWAS_FastTree))
 
# Load Gene distribution across samples
gene_presence_absence <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.1.Main_analysis/gene_presence_absence.Rtab", header=T)
gene_sig <- gene_presence_absence |> 
  filter(Gene %in% PanGWAS_FastTree_sig$variant)
gene_sig_Sum_prop <- gene_sig|>
  mutate(Sum = rowSums(across(2:ncol(gene_sig)), na.rm = TRUE),
         Proportion = round(Sum / (ncol(gene_sig)-1), 3))|>
  select(Gene, Sum, Proportion)
gene_sig_Sum_prop
gene_sig <- gene_sig |>
  mutate(across(2:1541, ~ ifelse(grepl("1", .), "present", "absent")))
gene_sig_t <- as.data.frame(t(gene_sig[,-1]))
colnames(gene_sig_t) <- gene_sig[[1]]

# Prepare heatmap data for phylo
## arnC
Metadata_arnC = gene_sig_t |> select(arnC)
Metadata_arnC$arnC <- as.factor(Metadata_arnC$arnC)
row.names(Metadata_arnC) <-  row.names(gene_sig_t)
colnames(Metadata_arnC)= c("arnC")
## group_1981
Metadata_group_1981 = gene_sig_t |> select(group_1981)
Metadata_group_1981$group_1981 <- as.factor(Metadata_group_1981$group_1981)
row.names(Metadata_group_1981) <-  row.names(gene_sig_t)
colnames(Metadata_group_1981)= c("group_1981")

# arnC
Fasttree_p22 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_p21 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_arnC ,  width=0.05, offset=0.052, 
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_x = -0.002, colnames_offset_y = -100, color=NA, colnames_angle = 60)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "darkred"), name="Gene") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") 

# group_1981
Fasttree_p23 <- gheatmap(Fasttree_p22 + new_scale_fill(), Metadata_group_1981,  width=0.05, offset=0.054,
               font.size = 5, colnames_offset_x = -0.002, colnames_offset_y = -150, color=NA, colnames_angle = 60)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "darkred"), name="group_1981")+
```

# Pairwise distances
```{r}
# SNPs
as.matrix(dist(sig_SNPs$POS, method = "manhattan")) 

# Unitigs 
DBGWAS_FastTree_sig |>
  filter(variant %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(variant)  |>
  mutate(Unitig= paste0("Unitig_", 1:12))|>
  arrange(contig, start) |>
  group_by(contig) |>
  mutate(
    start = as.numeric(start),
    end = as.numeric(end),
    distance_from_prev = start - lag(end)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
         
DBGWAS_FastTree_sig |>
  filter(variant %in% order_unitigs) |>
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, levels = order_unitigs)) |>
  arrange(variant)  |>
  mutate(Unitig= paste0("Unitig_", 1:12))|>
  arrange(start)|>
  mutate(y = factor(1:nrow(DBGWAS_FastTree_sig), levels = rev(1:nrow(DBGWAS_FastTree_sig)))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = (start), xend = end, y = y, yend = y, color= Unitig)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ contig, scales = "free") +
  geom_segment(linewidth = 2) +
  labs(x = "Position", y = "Variant") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  scale_color_manual(values=SC_colors)
```

```{r}
df_complete <- left_join(left_join(left_join(metadata_tree_v0 ,

                          Unitig_sig_t |> mutate(label=rownames(Unitig_sig_t))),
```
